experiment: forecaster_h3 (A1 independent LLM vs A5 gated MAS)
interpretation: A1 = a plain LLM call given the same raw prices+news (no model output); A5 = the gated MAS. Metric = directional accuracy on the most-confident top-k of each (abstains excluded — an abstain is not a wrong bet). A well-calibrated confidence ⇒ DA rises as coverage tightens.

regression.note: Lower is better. CMTF optimises rank/decision skill, not point error.

full_metrics.note: Sharpe is a sign-based proxy WITHOUT transaction costs (project convention); the cost columns show that the LLM's higher coverage pays proportionally more cost. DA alone is not comparable across different coverages — read coverage + Sharpe + cost + drawdown together. Regression (RMSE/MAE) is reported for completeness and may favour either system.
